topic: stop a leaky outdoor garden hose spigot
core_question: How do I fix an outdoor hose bib/spigot that leaks around the handle when it's turned on? (secondary: How do I get a dried blood stain out of fabric?)
answer_summary: Shut off the water, disassemble the spigot stem, and replace the worn rubber packing washer at the end of the stem, then reassemble.; after the topic shift: Soak in cold water (never hot, which sets the stain), apply hydrogen peroxide or an enzyme cleaner directly, gently rub, and rinse repeatedly before washing normally.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
